23254-the-cobbler-in-the-devil-s-kitchen.title: The Cobbler In The Devil S Kitchen From Mackinac And Lake St
23254-the-cobbler-in-the-devil-s-kitchen.creator: Mary Hartwell Catherwood
23254-the-cobbler-in-the-devil-s-kitchen.description: A book by Mary Hartwell Catherwood. In the east side of the Kitchen was a natural tiny fireplace a couple of feet high, screened by cedar foliage from the lake wind. Here Owen cooked his meals, and the smoke was generally carried out from his flueless hearth. The straits were then full of fish, and he had not far to throw his lines to reach deep water.

860-baby-mine.title: Baby Mine
860-baby-mine.creator: Margaret Mayo
860-baby-mine.description: A book by Margaret Mayo. “There's just one impractical feature about it.” He was conscious of a slight feeling of heresy when he admitted even ONE flaw in his friend's scheme of things. “Where is Alfred to find such a wife?”

arxiv-2004-06069.title: A tale of two toolkits, report the third: on the usage and performance of HIVE-COTE v1.0
arxiv-2004-06069.creator: Anthony Bagnall, Michael Flynn, James Large, Jason Lines, Matthew Middlehurst
arxiv-2004-06069.description: Abstract The Hierarchical Vote Collective of Transformation-based Ensembles (HIVE-COTE) is a heterogeneous meta ensemble for time series classification. Since it was first proposed in 2016, the algorithm has undergone some minor changes and there is now a configurable, scalable and easy to use version available in two open source repositories.

arxiv-2101-12165.title: Poncelet–Darboux, Kippenhahn, and Szegő: interactions between projective geometry, matrices and orthogonal polynomials
arxiv-2101-12165.creator: Markus Hunziker, Andrei Martínez-Finkelshtein, Taylor Poe, Brian Simanek
arxiv-2101-12165.description: A 2021 arXiv research paper by Markus Hunziker, Andrei Martínez-Finkelshtein, Taylor Poe, Brian Simanek. We study algebraic curves that are envelopes of families of polygons supported on the unit circle 𝕋 \mathbb{T} . We address, in particular, a characterization of such curves of minimal class and show that all realizations of these curves are essentially equivalent and can be described in terms of orthogonal polynomials on the unit circle (OPUC), also known as Szegő polynomials.

arxiv-2201-09838.title: On the Reducedness of Quiver Schemes
arxiv-2201-09838.creator: Yehao Zhou
arxiv-2201-09838.description: Abstract . In this paper we prove that a quiver scheme in characteristic zero is reduced if the moment map is flat. We use the reducedness result to show that the equivariant integration formula computes the K-theoretic Nekrasov partition function of five dimensional 𝒩 = 2 \mathcal{N}=2 quiver gauge theories when the moment map is flat.

arxiv-2209-02945.title: Heat Flux and Wall Shear Stress in Large Aspect-Ratio Turbulent Vertical Convection
arxiv-2209-02945.creator: Emily S.C. Ching
arxiv-2209-02945.description: Abstract We present a theoretical analysis of large aspect-ratio turbulent vertical convection that yields two relationships between heat flux and wall shear stress, measured respectively by the Nusselt number ( Nu ) and shear Reynolds number ( Re τ \text{Re}_{\tau} ), in terms of the Rayleigh ( Ra ) and Prandtl numbers ( Pr ): Re τ 2 ​ Nu

The author is grateful to Alexander Borisenko for many useful and illuminating discussions on the topic of Blaschke’s theorem throughout the years, and to Sebastian Boldt for continued encouragement t
arxiv-2404-02739.creator: Kostiantyn Drach
arxiv-2404-02739.description: Abstract . We generalize the classical Blaschke Rolling Theorem to convex domains in Riemannian manifolds of bounded sectional curvature and arbitrary dimension. Our results are sharp and, in this sharp form, are new even in the model spaces of constant curvature. 2010 Mathematics Subject Classification 53C40 1.

arxiv-2412-04615.title: Which subsets and when orbits prefer to visit in multidimensional non-Markovian non-uniformly expanding systems
arxiv-2412-04615.creator: Leonid A. Bunimovich, Yaofeng Su
arxiv-2412-04615.description: Abstract The paper addresses some basic questions about finite time dynamics for slowly mixing non-uniformly expanding dynamical systems. It is concerned with transport in phase spaces of such systems, and analyzes which subsets and when the orbits prefer to visit. An asymptotic expansion with explicit coefficients for the decay of polynomial escape rates is obtained.

arxiv-2502-08095.title: Instability of Slowly Expanding FLRW Spacetimes
arxiv-2502-08095.creator: Elliot Marshall
arxiv-2502-08095.description: Abstract . We numerically study, under a Gowdy symmetry assumption, nonlinear perturbations of the decelerated FLRW fluid solutions to the Einstein-Euler system toward the future for linear equations of state p = K ​ ρ p=K\rho with 0 ≤ K ≤ 1 0\leq K\leq 1 . This article builds on the work of Fajman et al.

arxiv-2601-18766.title: Learning to Discover: A Generalized Framework for Raga Identification without Forgetting
arxiv-2601-18766.description: Abstract Raga identification in Indian Art Music (IAM) remains challenging due to the presence of numerous rarely performed Ragas that are not represented in available training datasets. Traditional classification models struggle in this setting, as they assume a closed set of known categories and therefore fail to recognise or meaningfully group previously unseen Ragas.

pmc-10675436.title: Baseline-Free Damage Imaging of Composite Lap Joint via Parallel Array of Piezoelectric Sensors
pmc-10675436.creator: Mohsen Barzegar, Artur L. Ribeiro, Dario J. Pasadas, Aadhik Asokkumar, Renaldas Raišutis, Helena G. Ramos
pmc-10675436.description: This paper presents a baseline-free damage imaging technique using a parallel array of piezoelectric sensors and a control board that facilitates custom combinations of sensor selection. This technique incorporates an imaging algorithm that uses parallel beams for generation and reception of ultrasonic guided waves in a pitch–catch configuration.

pmc-11425104.title: Study on the evaluation method of pilot workload in eVTOL aircraft operation
pmc-11425104.creator: Lijuan Hu, Xufei Yan, Ye Yuan
pmc-11425104.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2024). This paper investigates the pilot control strategy and workload associated with the manned electric Vertical Take-Off and Landing (eVTOL) aircraft. This research aims to identify control strategies that are both rational and effective in reducing the pilot's workload. Although the Cooper-Harper rating (HQR, Handling Quality Rating) remains the prevalent benchmark for assessing pilot workload, its subjective nature often complicates the precise quantitative identification of the key factors influencing workload.

pmc-12525276.title: Molecular Adaptations to Repeated Radiation Exposure in Triple-Negative Breast Cancer: Dysregulation of Cell Adhesion, Mitochondrial Function, and Epithelial–Mesenchymal Transition
pmc-12525276.creator: Noah Dickinson, Alyssa Murray, Megan Davis, Kaitlyn Marshall-Bergeron, Jessica Dougherty, Wuroud Al-Khayyat, Ramya Narendrula, Maggie Lavoie, Emma Mageau, Ronan Derbowka, A Thomas Kovala, Douglas R Boreham, Natalie Lefort, Christopher Thome, Tze Chun Tai, Sujeenthar Tharmalingam, Fabrizio Fontana
pmc-12525276.description: Radiation resistance presents a significant challenge in the treatment of triple-negative breast cancer (TNBC). To investigate the molecular adaptations associated with radiation therapy resistance, MDA-MB-231 cells were subjected to a repeated radiation (RR) regimen totaling 57 Gy over 11 weeks, followed by clonal selection.

pmc-12693049.title: When Rewiring Fails—The Enduring Role of the Pectoralis Major Flap in Sternal Wound Reconstruction
pmc-12693049.creator: Viktoria Koenig, Alexandra Christ, Maximilian Monai, Martin Andreas, Daniel Zimpfer, Wolfgang Happak, Paul Werner
pmc-12693049.description: Background: Deep sternal wound infections (DSWIs) remain a serious complication after median sternotomy, often requiring complex wound management strategies. While modern approaches include vacuum-assisted closure (VAC) and plating techniques, the pedicled pectoralis major muscle flap (PMF) continues to play a pivotal role in surgical reconstruction, especially in cases with sternal destruction or osteomyelitis.

pmc-13251363.title: Class E sortase SrtE and two SrtE-dependent cell wall-anchored hydrophobic proteins are involved in morphogenesis in Actinoplanes missouriensis: occurrence of exploratory growth beyond genus Streptomyces

pmc-13251363.description: The actinomycete Actinoplanes missouriensis grows by extending branched hyphae and forms terminal sporangia containing a few hundred spores. A sortase-dependent spore surface protein, SspA, has recently been shown to be important for sporangium maturation in A. missouriensis. In this study, we functionally characterized all five sortase candidates in A.

pmc-13401926.title: Metabolic Reprogramming-Targeted Therapeutic Strategies in Primary Liver Cancer: A Bibliometric and Visualized Analysis
pmc-13401926.creator: Qiwei Yang, Lin Yu, Yishan Peng, Qing Yuan, Ning Fan, Genshu Wang
pmc-13401926.description: BackgroundMetabolic reprogramming has emerged as a critical hallmark and promising therapeutic target in primary liver cancer (PLC), including hepatocellular carcinoma (HCC) and intrahepatic cholangiocarcinoma (iCCA). However, the global research landscape, collaboration patterns, and evolving hotspots of metabolism-targeted therapeutic strategies in PLC remain unclear.
